name: EvidenceAI
description: An AI-powered developer portfolio that integrates an LLM-based assistant with RAG to answer questions about skills, projects, and experience, while retrieving and presenting relevant evidence from the portfolio to support its responses.

Component-Based UI.description: Built the portfolio interface using reusable React components with dynamic rendering of portfolio content, conversations, responses, and supporting evidence.

UI Styling & Icons.description: Styled the interface using custom CSS and Bootstrap components, with Google Material Icons for interface actions and visual elements.

Conversation State Management.description: Managed conversation history and user interactions using React state to maintain context throughout the assistant session.

API Integration.description: Connected the frontend to FastAPI endpoints using fetch requests to send user questions and trigger LLM-based responses when users select technology skills.

Streaming Response Handling.description: Processed streamed backend responses to progressively display generated summaries and supporting evidence in the interface.

API Service.description: Built FastAPI endpoints that receive user queries and selected skills from the frontend and coordinate the assistant's retrieval and response-generation workflow.

RAG Pipeline Integration.description: Implemented the backend workflow for query classification, parallel retrieval, context processing, and evidence-grounded response generation.

Streaming Responses.description: Implemented response streaming to deliver the generated summary to the frontend before returning the supporting evidence.

LLM-Based Query Classification.description: Used few-shot prompting with an LLM to classify user questions and generate relevant retrieval queries for the portfolio knowledge base.

Semantic Retrieval.description: Generated multiple retrieval queries and performed parallel semantic searches over embedded portfolio information to retrieve relevant evidence.

Evidence-Grounded Generation.description: Combined the user question, retrieved context, and conversation history to generate Markdown responses, streaming the summary first and supporting evidence afterward.

Repository Preprocessing.description: Consolidated project repositories using Repomix to prepare their source files and project structure for LLM-based analysis and knowledge extraction.

LLM Knowledge Extraction.description: Used an LLM with custom prompting to transform repository content into structured technical knowledge covering project overview, architecture, file-level implementation, technologies, and component relationships.

Hybrid Chunking.description: Processed the generated portfolio knowledge using a hybrid chunking strategy and attached relevant metadata to each chunk to preserve its source and context.

Vector Data Storage.description: Generated embeddings for the processed chunks and stored the chunks, embeddings, and associated metadata in ChromaDB to support semantic search and evidence retrieval.

File Change Detection.description: Used GitHub Actions to detect changes in project source files and trigger the appropriate workflow to keep the evidence used by the RAG system up to date.

Frontend Deployment.description: Implemented a GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow that automatically installs dependencies, builds the Vite React frontend, and deploys the production build to GitHub Pages whenever frontend changes are pushed to the main branch.

Backend Deployment.description: Implemented a CI/CD pipeline using Google Cloud Build to automatically build the FastAPI backend into a Docker container and deploy it to Google Cloud Run.

key_features.AI Portfolio Assistant: Ask questions about Prajakta's skills, projects, experience, and technical background.
key_features.Project Exploration: Explore project details, key features, technical implementation, technology stack, and data flow.
key_features.Skill-Based Exploration: Select a technology from a project's tech stack to see how it was used in projects.
key_features.Evidence-Backed Answers: View evidence presented by assistant to support responses to user’s questions.
key_features.Context-Aware Responses: Continue conversations while the assistant uses recent questions and responses to maintain context.
key_features.Resume Access: View and download Prajakta's resume for a complete overview of her qualifications and experience.
key_features.Contact Information: View available contact details for professional inquiries and opportunities.

data_flow.Portfolio Presentation: The React interface displays the portfolio and EvidenceAI assistant side by side when the website loads.
data_flow.Portfolio Exploration: Users navigate through the portfolio to explore background information, projects, technical skills, and other portfolio content.
data_flow.Project Exploration: Users select a project to view its dedicated project details and explore its features, technical implementation, and data flow.
data_flow.Global Skill Exploration: When a user selects a technology skill from the main portfolio page, the frontend sends the skill to the backend to retrieve evidence showing how it was used across projects.
data_flow.Project-Specific Skill Exploration: When a user selects a technology skill from a project details page, the frontend sends the project and skill context to the backend to retrieve evidence specific to that project.
data_flow.Question Submission: Users submit technical questions through the EvidenceAI assistant, while conversation history is maintained in React state.
data_flow.Query Classification: The backend uses an LLM with few-shot prompting to classify the question and generate relevant retrieval queries.
data_flow.Semantic Retrieval: Multiple retrieval queries are used to search the ChromaDB vector store for relevant portfolio information and supporting evidence.
data_flow.Context Processing: Retrieved evidence is combined with the user question, conversation history, and relevant project or skill context for response generation.
data_flow.Response Generation: The assistant LLM generates an evidence-grounded Markdown response using the retrieved portfolio information.
data_flow.Response Streaming: The backend streams the generated summary to the React frontend first, followed by the supporting evidence.
